description: Capture device screen state. Returns a downscaled JPEG screenshot (image content) and/or pruned interactive UI element tree with stable references (e.g. e1, e2). Prefer this before acting. Use returned element refs or coordinates directly in devicely_tap.

device.description: Target device name, serial, or UDID

include.description: Components to capture: "image" (screenshot), "elements" (interactive UI tree), or both

interactiveOnly.description: Prune non-interactive containers to keep tokens minimal (default true)

maxEdge.description: Maximum pixel dimension for screenshot long edge

maxElements.description: Maximum UI elements to return (capped at 500)

query.description: Filter UI elements by text, ID, or label substring

name: devicely_snapshot
